title: Institutional PM morning investment-committee review
business_question: Assess overnight rates and credit-risk implications for Portfolio A. Summarize evidence, assumptions, risks, and the next human review step. Do not place or recommend an order.
business_objective: Help an institutional portfolio manager prepare a traceable, risk-aware morning committee review while preserving authorization, provenance, guardrails, and human approval.

required_controls: deterministic macro, quantitative, and fixed-income calculations

benchmark_modes.name: controlled_synthesis
benchmark_modes.purpose: Give every model identical deterministic evidence and calculations so narration quality and governance can be compared.
benchmark_modes.model_responsibility: Evidence-linked committee summary only; no model-selected tools.

benchmark_modes.name: full_agentic
benchmark_modes.purpose: Give every model the same tool contracts and require tool selection, delegation, argument construction, retries, and synthesis.
benchmark_modes.model_responsibility: Choose and call governed tools; all calls are re-authorized at the tool boundary.

providers.observed_scope: Day 4/5 portfolio-risk and delegation exercises, not the exact canonical capstone question
providers.governance: not scored as part of the canonical capstone

providers.cost_basis: AWS Cost Explorer account/day estimate; not request-attributed
providers.governance: approval required; no order execution; temporary runtime torn down
providers.source: experiments/runs/ (see the generated report evidence links)

providers.observed_scope: Exact-input hosted Claude versus Llama comparison
providers.cost_basis: AWS Cost Explorer same-day account estimate shared with comparison; not model-attributed
providers.governance: approval required; no order execution; temporary runtime torn down
providers.source: experiments/runs/ (see the generated report evidence links)
